query: Which human factors endpoints (task success rate, critical user errors, time‑to‑result in intrapartum simulations), sample volumes, and ≤1‑hour training metrics will define usability acceptance?

response.query: Which human factors endpoints (task success rate, critical user errors, time‑to‑result in intrapartum simulations), sample volumes, and ≤1‑hour training metrics will define usability acceptance?
response.answer: Usability acceptance is defined by task success rate, critical user errors, and ≤1-hour training metrics. Sample volumes are not specified. Time-to-result in intrapartum simulations is also a key endpoint.
